labels.Channel is disconnected: Channel is disconnected. Click Reconnect to connect again.
labels.Channel failed: Channel setup failed. Check error message below.
labels.Waiting for QR scan: Scan the QR Code with WhatsApp to connect
labels.Creating resources: Creating WhatsApp session and Chat / Connection...
labels.Waiting for WAHA link: Scan the QR Code with the same WhatsApp number to link the send companion. This enables free-form replies outside the 24h window.

tooltips.oAuthAccount: The Meta OAuth Account used for authentication with WhatsApp Cloud API
tooltips.businessAccountId: The WhatsApp Business Account discovered from the Meta OAuth Account
tooltips.phoneNumber: The phone number associated with this WhatsApp connection
tooltips.phoneNumberId: The Meta Phone Number ID for WhatsApp Cloud API
tooltips.credential: Legacy credential link (replaced by Meta Account + Business Account selection)
tooltips.instagramId: The Instagram-scoped account ID (user_id) used by Instagram webhooks and messaging.
tooltips.instagramUsername: The Instagram username of the authenticated Business Account.
tooltips.instagramBusinessAccountId: The Instagram Business Account discovered from the Meta OAuth Account.
tooltips.wahaChatwootInboxId: The Chat / Inbox ID of the send-only WAHA companion linked to this coexistence number. Free-form replies outside the 24h window are routed through it.
tooltips.chatwootInboxIdentifier: The inbox identifier used for webhooks
tooltips.wahaIgnoreStatus: Ignore Status updates (stories). No webhooks or stored messages for status@broadcast.
tooltips.wahaIgnoreGroups: Ignore Group chats. No webhooks or stored messages for group conversations.
tooltips.wahaIgnoreChannels: Ignore Channel messages. No webhooks or stored messages for channels.
tooltips.wahaIgnoreBroadcast: Ignore Broadcast lists (*@broadcast), excluding status@broadcast. Use 'Ignore Status' for Status.
tooltips.autoPendingEnabled: When enabled, conversations in this inbox will automatically move to 'Pending' status after an agent sends a message. This helps track conversations waiting for customer response.

messages.channelCreated: Channel created. Click Activate to start the connection.
messages.channelActivated: Channel activation started. Scan the QR code to connect WhatsApp.
messages.confirmDisconnect: Are you sure you want to disconnect this channel? The WhatsApp session will be stopped.
messages.confirmActivate: This will create a WAHA session and Chat / Inbox. Continue?
messages.confirmReactivate: This will repair the WhatsApp connection by recreating the WAHA session and app. Your existing inbox and conversations are preserved, but you may need to scan the QR code again. Continue?
messages.confirmActivateInstagram: This will connect the Instagram Business Account to Chatwoot and create a Chat / Inbox. Continue?
